text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

texts.asv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
texts.web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

texts.asv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
texts.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

text: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

texts.asv: For I, Jehovah thy God, will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
texts.web: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

text: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

texts.asv: They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.
texts.web: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

text: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

texts.asv: Many waters cannot quench love, Neither can floods drown it: If a man would give all the substance of his house for love, He would utterly be contemned.
texts.web: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

texts.asv: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
texts.web: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

texts.asv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
texts.web: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

texts.asv: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
texts.web: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

texts.asv: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
texts.web: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

texts.asv: For thus said the Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. And ye would not:
texts.web: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

texts.asv: because if thou shalt confess with thy mouth Jesus as Lord, and shalt believe in thy heart that God raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved:
texts.web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

texts.asv: The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah is upon me; because Jehovah hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
texts.web: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

texts.asv: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
texts.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

text: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

texts.asv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
texts.web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

texts.asv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
texts.web: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

texts.asv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
texts.web: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

text: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

texts.asv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus, and thou shalt be saved, thou and thy house.
texts.web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

texts.asv: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.
texts.web: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

texts.asv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
texts.web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

texts.asv: and he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall be no more; neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more: the first things are passed away.
texts.web: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

texts.asv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of good courage; be not affrighted, neither be thou dismayed: for Jehovah thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
texts.web: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

texts.asv: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
texts.web: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

texts.asv: For God sent not the Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.
texts.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

texts.asv: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.
texts.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

texts.asv: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:
texts.web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

texts.asv: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
texts.web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

text: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

texts.asv: Jehovah, the Lord, is my strength; And he maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, And will make me to walk upon my high places.
texts.web: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

texts.asv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
texts.web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

texts.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
texts.web: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

texts.asv: For what shall a man be profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and forfeit his life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
texts.web: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

texts.asv: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.
texts.web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

texts.asv: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
texts.web: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

texts.asv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of God.
texts.web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

texts.asv: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
texts.web: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

texts.asv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
texts.web: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

texts.asv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
texts.web: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

texts.asv: Every scripture inspired of God is also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness:
texts.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

texts.asv: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.
texts.web: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

text: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

texts.asv: He that maketh many friends doeth it to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
texts.web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

text: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

texts.asv: The eternal God is thy dwelling-place, And underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy from before thee, And said, Destroy.
texts.web: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

texts.asv: I can do all things in him that strengtheneth me.
texts.web: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

text: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

texts.asv: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
texts.web: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

texts.asv: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
texts.web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

texts.asv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed to us-ward.
texts.web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

texts.asv: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
texts.web: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

texts.asv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
texts.web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

texts.asv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
texts.web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

texts.asv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
texts.web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

texts.asv: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
texts.web: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

texts.asv: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.
texts.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

texts.asv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honorable, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
texts.web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

text: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

texts.asv: Only fear Jehovah, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider how great things he hath done for you.
texts.web: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

texts.asv: But godliness with contentment is great gain:
texts.web: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

texts.asv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and will show thee great things, and difficult, which thou knowest not.
texts.web: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

texts.asv: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
texts.web: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

text: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

texts.asv: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him cometh my salvation.
texts.web: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

texts.asv: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
texts.web: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

texts.asv: Again therefore Jesus spake unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
texts.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

texts.asv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor as thyself.
texts.web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

texts.asv: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
texts.web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

texts.asv: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
texts.web: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

texts.asv: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
texts.web: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

texts.asv: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.
texts.web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

texts.asv: let us hold fast the confession of our hope that it waver not; for he is faithful that promised:
texts.web: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

texts.asv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as man can bear: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation make also the way of escape, that ye may be able to endure it.
texts.web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

text: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

texts.asv: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
texts.web: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

texts.asv: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
texts.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

text: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

texts.asv: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.
texts.web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

texts.asv: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.
texts.web: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

texts.asv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
texts.web: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

texts.asv: For no word from God shall be void of power.
texts.web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

texts.asv: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.
texts.web: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

texts.asv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
texts.web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

texts.asv: I say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.
texts.web: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

text: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

texts.asv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
texts.web: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

texts.asv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.
texts.web: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

texts.asv: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.
texts.web: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

texts.asv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.
texts.web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

texts.asv: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning.
texts.web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

text: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

texts.asv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
texts.web: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

texts.asv: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.web: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

texts.asv: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
texts.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

texts.asv: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my lovingkindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall my covenant of peace be removed, saith Jehovah that hath mercy on thee.
texts.web: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.

text: [A Song of degrees.] I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

texts.asv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
texts.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

texts.asv: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
texts.web: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

text: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

texts.asv: And let us know, let us follow on to know Jehovah: his going forth is sure as the morning; and he will come unto us as the rain, as the latter rain that watereth the earth.
texts.web: Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

text: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

texts.asv: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then will relief and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place, but thou and thy father’s house will perish: and who knoweth whether thou art not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
texts.web: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

texts.asv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
texts.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

text: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

texts.asv: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.
texts.web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

texts.asv: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.
texts.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

texts.asv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
texts.web: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

texts.asv: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.
texts.web: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

texts.asv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
texts.web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

texts.asv: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
texts.web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

text: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

texts.asv: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
texts.web: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.

texts.asv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith Jehovah.
texts.web: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.

text: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

texts.asv: Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
texts.web: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

texts.asv: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;
texts.web: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, “The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

texts.asv: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.
texts.web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

texts.asv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.
texts.web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

texts.asv: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;
texts.web: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

texts.asv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.
texts.web: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

texts.asv: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
texts.web: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

texts.asv: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
texts.web: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

text: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

texts.asv: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
texts.web: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

text: [A Song of degrees of David.] Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

texts.asv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
texts.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

texts.asv: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
texts.web: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

texts.asv: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
texts.web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

texts.asv: And he saith unto them, Because of your little faith: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
texts.web: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

text: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

texts.asv: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.
texts.web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

texts.asv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith Jehovah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope in your latter end.
texts.web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

text: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

texts.asv: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
texts.web: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

texts.asv: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
texts.web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

texts.asv: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
texts.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

texts.asv: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
texts.web: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

texts.asv: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring ye ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
texts.web: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

text: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

texts.asv: Jehovah will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
texts.web: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

text: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

texts.asv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.
texts.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

texts.asv: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;
texts.web: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

texts.asv: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.
texts.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

texts.asv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
texts.web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

texts.asv: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, a conviction of things not seen.
texts.web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

texts.asv: But if any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all liberally and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
texts.web: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

text: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

texts.asv: For the Son of man also came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
texts.web: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

texts.asv: Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger, and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
texts.web: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

texts.asv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
texts.web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

text: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

texts.asv: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?
texts.web: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

text: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

texts.asv: Blessed be Jehovah, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.
texts.web: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

text: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

texts.asv: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
texts.web: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

texts.asv: He hath showed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth Jehovah require of thee, but to do justly, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with thy God?
texts.web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

texts.asv: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations;
texts.web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

texts.asv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
texts.web: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

texts.asv: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
texts.web: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

texts.asv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
texts.web: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

texts.asv: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
texts.web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

texts.asv: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
texts.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

text: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

texts.asv: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
texts.web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

texts.asv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
texts.web: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

texts.asv: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
texts.web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

texts.asv: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
texts.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

texts.asv: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
texts.web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

texts.asv: And Peter said unto them, Repent ye, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ unto the remission of your sins; and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
texts.web: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

texts.asv: Rejoice in the Lord always: again I will say, Rejoice.
texts.web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

texts.asv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labor is not vain in the Lord.
texts.web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

texts.asv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.
texts.web: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

text: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

texts.asv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
texts.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

texts.asv: Wherefore if any man is in Christ, he is a new creature: the old things are passed away; behold, they are become new.
texts.web: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

text: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

texts.asv: It is of Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
texts.web: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

texts.asv: Ye are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid.
texts.web: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

texts.asv: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:
texts.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

texts.asv: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old he will not depart from it.
texts.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

texts.asv: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
texts.web: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

texts.asv: Ye are of God, my little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
texts.web: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

text: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

texts.asv: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
texts.web: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

texts.asv: Love suffereth long, and is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
texts.web: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

texts.asv: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
texts.web: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

text: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

texts.asv: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
texts.web: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

text: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.] God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

texts.asv: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
texts.web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

text: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

texts.asv: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that take refuge in him.
texts.web: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

text: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

texts.asv: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:
texts.web: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

text: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

texts.asv: He giveth power to the faint; and to him that hath no might he increaseth strength.
texts.web: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

text: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

texts.asv: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
texts.web: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

texts.asv: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
texts.web: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

texts.asv: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.
texts.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

texts.asv: Honor thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be long in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
texts.web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

texts.asv: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
texts.web: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

text: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

texts.asv: But now, O Jehovah, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
texts.web: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

texts.asv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate thereon day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
texts.web: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

texts.asv: Therefore I say unto you, All things whatsoever ye pray and ask for, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
texts.web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

texts.asv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.
texts.web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

texts.asv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
texts.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

texts.asv: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
texts.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

text: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

texts.asv: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.
texts.web: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.

text: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

texts.asv: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
texts.web: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

text: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

texts.asv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
texts.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

texts.asv: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
texts.web: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

texts.asv: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.
texts.web: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

texts.asv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.
texts.web: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

texts.asv: All things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
texts.web: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

text: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

texts.asv: For the eyes of Jehovah run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
texts.web: For the LORD’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

texts.asv: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
texts.web: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

texts.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
texts.web: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

texts.asv: I press on toward the goal unto the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
texts.web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

texts.asv: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
texts.web: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

texts.asv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.
texts.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

text: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

texts.asv: Jehovah appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
texts.web: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

texts.asv: This is the end of the matter; all hath been heard: Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
texts.web: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

text: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

texts.asv: But Jehovah said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have rejected him: for Jehovah seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but Jehovah looketh on the heart.
texts.web: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.”

text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

texts.asv: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

texts.asv: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
texts.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

texts.asv: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
texts.web: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

texts.asv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
texts.web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

texts.asv: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
texts.web: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

texts.asv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
texts.web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

texts.asv: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
texts.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

texts.asv: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
texts.web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

texts.asv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
texts.web: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

texts.asv: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.
texts.web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

texts.asv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
texts.web: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

texts.asv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
texts.web: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

text: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

texts.asv: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
texts.web: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

text: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

texts.asv: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
texts.web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

texts.asv: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:
texts.web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

text: [A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.] O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

texts.asv: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
texts.web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

texts.asv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
texts.web: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

text: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

texts.asv: For I, Jehovah, change not; therefore ye, O sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
texts.web: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

texts.asv: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
texts.web: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

texts.asv: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.
texts.web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

texts.asv: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
texts.web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

texts.asv: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help us in time of need.
texts.web: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

text: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.

texts.asv: Jehovah is my strength and song, And he is become my salvation: This is my God, and I will praise him; My father’s God, and I will exalt him.
texts.web: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

texts.asv: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;
texts.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

texts.asv: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee, for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;
texts.web: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

texts.asv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
texts.web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

texts.asv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been approved, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to them that love him.
