texts.web: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

texts.asv: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
texts.web: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

texts.asv: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, even Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.
texts.web: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

texts.asv: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
texts.web: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

texts.asv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
texts.web: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

texts.asv: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
texts.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

texts.asv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
texts.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

texts.asv: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:
texts.web: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

texts.asv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
texts.web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

texts.asv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.
texts.web: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

texts.asv: And Jehovah God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
texts.web: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

texts.asv: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
texts.web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

texts.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
texts.web: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text: [A Psalm of David.] Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

texts.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name.
texts.web: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

texts.asv: (for we walk by faith, not by sight);
texts.web: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

texts.asv: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.
texts.web: The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

texts.asv: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
texts.web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

texts.asv: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them: for Jehovah thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
texts.web: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

texts.asv: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
texts.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

texts.asv: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:
texts.web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

texts.asv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
texts.web: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

texts.asv: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.
texts.web: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

texts.asv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
texts.web: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

texts.asv: And we know that to them that love God all things work together for good, even to them that are called according to his purpose.
texts.web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

texts.asv: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: being ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
texts.web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

texts.asv: and above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfectness.
texts.web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

texts.asv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
texts.web: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

texts.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
texts.web: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

texts.asv: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
texts.web: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

texts.asv: Put on therefore, as God’s elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;
texts.web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

texts.asv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
texts.web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

texts.asv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
texts.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

texts.asv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
texts.web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

text: Let all your things be done with charity.

texts.asv: Let all that ye do be done in love.
texts.web: Let all that you do be done in love.

text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

texts.asv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
texts.web: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

texts.asv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
texts.web: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

text: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

texts.asv: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
texts.web: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

texts.asv: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
texts.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

texts.asv: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
texts.web: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

texts.asv: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
texts.web: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

texts.asv: In nothing be anxious; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
texts.web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

texts.asv: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, even as God also in Christ forgave you.
texts.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

texts.asv: but they that wait for Jehovah shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.
texts.web: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

texts.asv: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.
texts.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

texts.asv: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee:
texts.web: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.

text: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

texts.asv: Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for all things are possible with God.
texts.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

texts.asv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
texts.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

texts.asv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth on him should not perish, but have eternal life.
texts.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

texts.asv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
texts.web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

texts.asv: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.
texts.web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

texts.asv: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
texts.web: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

texts.asv: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.
texts.web: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

texts.asv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.
texts.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

texts.asv: Let each man do according as he hath purposed in his heart: not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
texts.web: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

text: Pray without ceasing.

texts.asv: pray without ceasing;
texts.web: Pray without ceasing.

text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

texts.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
texts.web: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

texts.asv: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
texts.web: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

texts.asv: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing:
texts.web: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

texts.asv: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
texts.web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

texts.asv: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
texts.web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

texts.asv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
texts.web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

texts.asv: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.
texts.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

texts.asv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
texts.web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

texts.asv: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
texts.web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

texts.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
texts.web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

texts.asv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee; because he trusteth in thee.
texts.web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

texts.asv: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
texts.web: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

texts.asv: and without faith it is impossible to be well-pleasing unto him; for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that seek after him.
texts.web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

texts.asv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
texts.web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

texts.asv: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
texts.web: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

texts.asv: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
texts.web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

texts.asv: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
texts.web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

texts.asv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
texts.web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

texts.asv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;
texts.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

text: Rejoice evermore.

texts.asv: Rejoice always;
texts.web: Always rejoice.

text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

texts.asv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
texts.web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

texts.asv: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
texts.web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

text: We love him, because he first loved us.

texts.asv: We love, because he first loved us.
texts.web: We love him, because he first loved us.

text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

texts.asv: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
texts.web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

texts.asv: And Jehovah, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
texts.web: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

texts.asv: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
texts.web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

texts.asv: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
texts.web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

texts.asv: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I that live, but Christ liveth in me: and that life which I now live in the flesh I live in faith, the faith which is in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
texts.web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

texts.asv: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
texts.web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

texts.asv: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
texts.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

texts.asv: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and quick to discern the thoughts and intents of the heart.
texts.web: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

texts.asv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
texts.web: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

texts.asv: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
texts.web: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

texts.asv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.
texts.web: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

texts.asv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
texts.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

texts.asv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them that are in Christ Jesus.
texts.web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

texts.asv: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
texts.web: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

texts.asv: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day, yea and for ever.
texts.web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

texts.asv: And in none other is there salvation: for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, wherein we must be saved.
texts.web: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

text: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

texts.asv: And a second like unto it is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
texts.web: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

texts.asv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
texts.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

texts.asv: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
texts.web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

texts.asv: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
texts.web: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

texts.asv: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
texts.web: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

texts.asv: but I say unto you, Love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
texts.web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

texts.asv: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:
texts.web: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

texts.asv: And he said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
texts.web: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

texts.asv: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:
texts.web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

texts.asv: and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Jehovah your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
texts.web: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

text: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

texts.asv: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth over the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in lovingkindness.
texts.web: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

text: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

texts.asv: Who is like unto thee, O Jehovah, among the gods? Who is like thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
texts.web: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

text: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:

texts.asv: Trust ye in Jehovah for ever; for in Jehovah, even Jehovah, is an everlasting rock.
texts.web: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

texts.asv: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
texts.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

texts.asv: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah.
texts.web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

texts.asv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
texts.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

texts.asv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, neither shadow that is cast by turning.
texts.web: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

text: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

texts.asv: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; But a woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.
texts.web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

texts.asv: So belief cometh of hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
texts.web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

texts.asv: but thanks be to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

texts.asv: I know that thou canst do all things, And that no purpose of thine can be restrained.
texts.web: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

texts.asv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.
texts.web: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD.

text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

texts.asv: if my people, who are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
texts.web: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

texts.asv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.
texts.web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

texts.asv: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,
texts.web: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

text: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

texts.asv: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Jehovah unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith Jehovah of hosts.
texts.web: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

texts.asv: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
texts.web: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

text: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

texts.asv: Ah Lord Jehovah! behold, thou hast made the heavens and the earth by thy great power and by thine outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for thee,
texts.web: “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

texts.asv: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:
texts.web: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

texts.asv: Even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
texts.web: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

texts.asv: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
texts.web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

texts.asv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall stand forever.
texts.web: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

texts.asv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
texts.web: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

texts.asv: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
texts.web: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.

text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

texts.asv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
texts.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

texts.asv: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.
texts.web: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

texts.asv: Iron sharpeneth iron; So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
texts.web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

texts.asv: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
texts.web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

texts.asv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto him for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye grieved; for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.
texts.web: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

texts.asv: And my God shall supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
texts.web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

texts.asv: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
texts.web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

texts.asv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;
texts.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

texts.asv: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.
texts.web: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

texts.asv: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God;
texts.web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

texts.asv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
texts.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

text: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.

texts.asv: but as it is written, Things which eye saw not, and ear heard not, And which entered not into the heart of man, Whatsoever things God prepared for them that love him.
texts.web: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

texts.asv: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
texts.web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

texts.asv: And Jesus looking upon them said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
texts.web: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

texts.asv: But now abideth faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
texts.web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

texts.asv: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.
texts.web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

texts.asv: doing nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;
texts.web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

texts.asv: My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
texts.web: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

texts.asv: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
texts.web: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

texts.asv: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
texts.web: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

texts.asv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
texts.web: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

texts.asv: But ye shall receive power, when the Holy Spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa and Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
texts.web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

texts.asv: fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
texts.web: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

text: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

texts.asv: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
texts.web: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
